scope: existing training/evaluation hitter population only; repair GP and demonstrated usage proxy, no clinical evidence collection
sources: Official public MLB Stats API complete regular-season aggregate hitting census; reuse preserved 2018,2024,2025,2026 sources
verification: unique MLBAM ID and requested season
exact PA agreement with preserved exposure within 1e-8
0<GP<=163 for positive workload; GP can exceed PA for pinch runners; historical regular-season tiebreak games can produce 163
no replacement of PA, status, zeros, missing exposure or debut evidence
correction: apply verified GP uniformly to both training and evaluation observations, including existing GP disagreement where PA matches; conflicts stay unresolved with reason
role_proxy: preserved PA/GP thresholds everyday>=3.8, platoon>=2.8, bench otherwise; unchanged PA-only incumbent fallback; full-usage thresholds unchanged
unidentifiable: state index4 renamed retention_unidentifiable; reason separate forecast-date role missing, target GP missing, or insufficient usage evidence. Not an injury or role-change label. Same five-state architecture and residual-state index.
prediction_information: observations restricted to year<=anchor; future only target_label; retrieval timestamps distinguish historical season evidence from asof medical intelligence
training: same inherited partitions, all fitting/calibration settings, weights, <=min(anchor,2025), target2020 excluded and inherited pitcher anchor2020 excluded. Same features; no extra GP feature or coverage predictor
unaffected_pitchers: reuse exact original fitted artifacts after checking positive GP/GS coverage and identical observations/features; do not introduce change for unaffected family
primary: raw expected workload without allocator, medical envelope or additional participation discount; scenario capacity separate
cohorts: freeze prior direct Cases.groups and protected_groups; report repaired forecast-role separately, no retrospective reclassification for primary matched cohort reports
metrics: joint-state Brier on repaired identifiable labels
selection: retain benchmark unless all protected gates satisfied, overall H and P MAE and RMSE no worse than benchmark; no parameter/candidate additions based on exposed scores
evaluation_status: all prior cases exposed exploratory; no fresh holdout known; independent confirmation required
source_collection: only complete required-season GP censuses; no error-based player selection, no additional transaction/medical collection
protected_gates: unchanged preceding release thresholds and populations; allocator/medical/independent confirmation not established
pre_score_amendment: Correct baseball validity constraint before retrieval/scoring; no modeling settings changed
